about: The SHA2-384 groups, written as plain HKDF: ikm = Z || T, salt as given, info = U partyId || U ephemeralData || V partyId || V ephemeralData || L in bits (4 bytes, big-endian). AFT cases are all "valid": HKDF-SHA-384(salt, ikm, info) to size bytes gives exactly okm. VAL cases say whether the okm given is the right one.
